<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Squad Leader''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍分隊指揮官</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">きっちり３人の兵員／トルーパーからなる“分隊”とともに移動する場合、１フォースで４人全員が移動できる。同じ位置カード上の兵員／トルーパーはそれぞれ没収値＋１。「帝国軍警備兵員」は分隊指揮官と一緒であれば移動可能となる（フォースは通常通り消費する）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Imperial-Squad-Leader-SWCA-100659.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">モッド・テリック大尉は、デザート・サンズ・サンドトルーパー部隊のごく典型的な士官である。勇敢で忠誠心が強い。必要とあらば、兵員たちを犠牲にすることも厭わない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Squad Leader.

'''Card text:'''
When moving with a “squad” of exactly three troopers, all four may move for 1 Force. Troopers at the same location card are each forfeit +1. Imperial Trooper Guards may move if they are with the squad leader, using Force as usual.

'''Lore:'''
Captain Mod Terrik is a typical officer of the Desert Sands sandtrooper unit. He is brave and loyal. If necessary, he does not hesitate to sacrifice his troops.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 位置カード where the English uses site, and 兵員／トルーパー for troopers.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Squad Leader]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
